suppress.notes: DOMPurify 3.4.13 bundled inside the swagger-ui webjar (springdoc's /api/swagger-ui page). GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p is low severity (CVSS 2.3) and needs DOMPurify's IN_PLACE mode with a node-removing afterSanitize hook, which is set by the calling code; Swagger UI only sanitizes the API description. Fixed in DOMPurify 3.4.16, but even swagger-ui 5.33.1 still bundles 3.4.13. Remove once a swagger-ui release ships the fix.
